face_atlas.prompt: Create a production facial animation sprite atlas for ONLY the same adult illustrated woman in the reference (age 28). Output a perfectly square image with EXACTLY 3 columns and 3 rows, nine equal square cells, no gaps, no grid lines, no labels and no text. Each cell shows the SAME tightly cropped face, from upper forehead to chin with a small hair border, same head angle, same facial identity, same eye size and placement, same skin color and warm lighting, identical scale and alignment. Match the reference's precise tilted head pose and mature refined semi-realistic anime style. No torso, no shoulders, no room. Every face must occupy the same position within its square cell; do not rotate, tilt or shift between cells. Row 1 left: reference relaxed neutral closed-mouth smile, both eyes open. Row 1 center: BOTH eyes fully closed natural blink, mouth identical neutral. Row 1 right: BOTH eyes half closed, mouth identical neutral. Row 2 left: eyes open, speaking A mouth vertically open with restrained dark mouth interior and a little upper teeth. Row 2 center: eyes open, speaking E/I mouth horizontally open, shallow opening with subtle upper teeth. Row 2 right: eyes open, speaking O rounded opening. Row 3 left: eyes open, speaking U small rounded pursed opening. Row 3 center: eyes open, M/B/P lips gently pressed together, closed. Row 3 right: eyes open, soft attentive closed-mouth smile, slightly lifted mouth corners. Only eyelids and lips change. Keep nose, cheekbones, jaw, hair, eyebrow shape, skin highlights and shadows identical across the nine cells. Mouth shapes should be moderate and natural, not exaggerated or cartoonishly wide. This is a precise expression asset, not nine different portraits. The atlas itself has an opaque neutral warm background.

registration.method: Read-only multiscale normalized cross-correlation of stable face regions; no generated image pixels were edited.
